attributes.description: Data access patterns across Snowflake access history, data transfer history, stages inventory, and external access history.

embeddableConfig.content:
This dashboard combines Snowflake access history, data transfer history, stages inventory, and external access history to highlight how data is queried, moved, and exposed. It surfaces top accessed objects and users, transfer volume trends, external stage configuration, and outbound external access events from UDF and procedure handlers. Use the controls to filter by user and transfer type.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/snowflake/overview)**
